meta.source: Research master tab 48_LOGO_LIBRARY and the research team chain-brand logo library Hotel_Chain_Logos_Web (every file SHA-256 checked against the manifest and the tab)
meta.identityRole: Identify the brand next to its name in labels, cards, lists and panels; the brand and hotel names stay the record of identity
meta.display: SVG and display-sized rasters (≤ 512 px, ≤ 64 KB) keep their bytes; larger rasters are scaled uniformly to 384 px (WebP) — no recolouring, ink cropping, tracing or upscaling
meta.backing: theme-invariant backing from the library recommended surface: light #FFFFFF, dark #182327; opaque files cover their own backing
